sourceFacts.branches: The 12 mode-changing modifier files (WPM_ERG_BurstFireEnabled_W10, _BurstFireReplace_W10, _FullAutoReplace_W30, _FullAutoReplaceVSSM_W50) are byte-identical by SHA-256; the set of _Ergo/FireMode routes is the same 11 before and after, so the 10 site choices and the two source-only branches stand.
sourceFacts.cmuSemiAutoImport: EA's note removes the Match Trigger from the SGX and L110. In the source, MPX_WB (SGX) and Minimi_WB (L110) each lost one import, the condition asset _Ergo/CMU_SemiAuto (GUID 443b41bc-f4b5-45e9-8d7c-3e4208121496): the GUID bytes sit at offset 26724 in the 1.4.3.5 MPX_WB and offset 26916 in the 1.4.3.5 Minimi_WB (read below); a byte search finds none in either 2.1.1.0 file (guid-search.json). Of the 63 existing weapons these are the only two that lost it; 41 of the other 61 _WB files import it (43 of 63 did on 1.4.3.5). CMU_SemiAuto is a two-object condition asset (one field, value 1) and is not specific to the Match Trigger (it is imported by weapons that do not offer one), so the loss shows that the semi-auto conditional modifiers no longer apply on these two, not by itself that a Match Trigger attachment was removed. Neither weapon has a Match Trigger attachment record in the catalog on either build.
sourceFacts.m433MatchTrigger: HK433_WB (M433) is the one weapon that gained a Match Trigger import (_Ergo/MatchTrigger/WPM_ERG_MatchTrigger_W15, GUID 36d9d2e2-d5e9-4075-9e9d-9f4c9d148cad, one hit at offset 26360 in the 2.1.1.0 file, none before); it keeps its CMU_SemiAuto import. Its mode list is unchanged (auto + single; the site offers the Match Trigger on it).
sourceFacts.newWeapons: Read, not diffed: Mk 24 auto 635.294, single 359.999; RSPR auto 719.999, single 399.999; Z84M auto 719.999 only; ELR-40 bolt (mode 1) 299.999. All equal the site's fireModes (the ELR-40 rate is a placeholder in RateOfFire; see L4055).

The two guid reads at 26724 and 26916 are in the 1.4.3.5 pre-update raw files (builds/1.4.3.5/capture/pre-update-60769-2026-10-12/collection/raw); the 2.1.1.0 absence is a byte search (guid-search.json), not a raw read, and is not a proof of runtime behaviour.

inference: Fire-mode lists and rates are unchanged on every existing weapon and the mode-changing modifier files are byte-identical. The CMU_SemiAuto import removal on the SGX and L110 and the added Match Trigger import on the M433 are serialized changes to the weapon bodies; what they change at runtime is not traced here.
unresolved: What HK433_WB's new direct import of WPM_ERG_MatchTrigger_W15 changes in the M433 (the M433 already offers the attachment) is not traced (open item 2 of the note, L4055).
Whether the lost CMU_SemiAuto import disables semi-auto conditional modifiers on the SGX and L110 at runtime is not established; no Match Trigger attachment record exists for either weapon.
The 2.1.1.0 absence of the CMU_SemiAuto GUID is a byte search over two files, recorded in guid-search.json.
siteImpact: None applied or proposed: the site's fireModes rates equal the 2.1.1.0 source on every weapon with a row (the pointers below are the SGX and L110 rates); the site offers the Match Trigger on the M433 and none on the SGX and L110.
